change_summary: Shadow-audited day1-to-day2 improving trigger quality for strict day-2 25% follow-through add-ons without changing shared strategy code.
hypothesis: Strict day-2 follow-through add-ons may become more material and less noisy if the trigger requires improving day1-to-day2 follow-through, rather than changing cap semantics or add-on size.
notes: Artifact: data/exp_20260426_034_entry_followthrough_improving_trigger_results.json. The improving trigger kept 10/14 executed normal add-ons, removed 4, and produced only +13.78 estimated aggregate PnL / +0.0019 EV versus normal 25% add-on, with 2 windows improved and 1 regressed. Decision: rejected; do not add a day1-to-day2 improving prefilter or spend another iteration on nearby trigger-quality filters without stronger adverse-add-on evidence.
